Company Description

Job Description:

8+ years of total IT experience with special focus on architecture, design, and development of Multi-channel eCommerce and J2EE applications

In-depth knowledge of various performance optimizations on client side, server side, and database

Experience working with application servers such as JBoss, and WebLogic

Ability to work with business users, product managers, QA, Release, UI and cross-functional teams

Strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to work in an unstructured, fast-paced environment

Experience working with offshore teams.
